clipAnnotations.attack: 1.2 s loop at native 1.0x speed: 2 beats (head lunge + chomp, sleeve slap); 1 plant bite per 0.6 s beat, 1 house hit per loop.
clipAnnotations.die: One-shot 2.0 s burn: catches fire, crumples to nothing, embers drift up; then freed.
clipAnnotations.walk: 1.6 s airborne gallop at native 1.0x: hover bob, paddling paper legs, fluttering tail, streamers and sleeves.

lore: A burnt offering that drifts above the lawn. Plants cannot touch it until it lands.
mechanism: Glider: a Hungry Ghost with 35 HP and a 0.9 m/s pace that glides in airborne (plants skip it, hits do nothing) and only touches down inside the touchdown_half_extent square around the pearl, so it sails over the outer plant row and bites from behind it. Visuals ride glide_height higher until touchdown. Weak bites (6 per 0.6 s) and weak siege (5 per 1.2 s). All march/seek/eat/siege AI, health bar and materials inherited.
name: Paper Effigy
